details: The pointermove handler calls drawEdges() and drawNodes() on every mouse event without RAF or debounce, triggering full canvas redraws of 400 nodes and 600 edges at 60fps; during active simulation ticks this can cause double-renders per frame. All other criteria pass: no cross-view dispatch loops, scales are correctly referenced via closure variables updated each tick, no D3 transitions are used so no mid-flight snap risk, and pointer events API properly unifies mouse/touch input.
